items.title: Fix Amazon Aurora MySQL error 63955: Virtual index ID overflow
items.summary: An Amazon Aurora MySQL cluster can exhaust its virtual index ID limit, after which any CREATE INDEX that includes a virtual column fails with error 63955 until you rebuild the databases. This post shows how to recognize the error, why backups cannot clear it, and how to run a logical dump-and-restore migration with monitoring to catch it next time.
items.creator: Kartik Saini

items.title: Improve RDS Proxy multiplexing for PostgreSQL, Part 1: Common causes
items.summary: RDS Proxy multiplexes many client connections across a small pool of database connections, but connection pinning, pool fragmentation, and uncommitted transactions can silently disable that benefit for PostgreSQL workloads. Part 1 shows how to recognize each condition with Amazon CloudWatch metrics and the fix that restores multiplexing.
items.creator: Pavel Rabinovich

items.title: Improve RDS Proxy multiplexing for PostgreSQL, Part 2: Diagnose and monitor
items.summary: Metrics alone can't always pinpoint what is reducing RDS Proxy multiplexing for PostgreSQL. Part 2 shows how to use Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights with enhanced proxy logs to find the root cause, what healthy multiplexing looks like in metrics and logs, and how to set up CloudWatch alarms that catch regression.
items.creator: Pavel Rabinovich
